style: Duo sitcom, Maya's room by day (drifting cloud in the window, shelf, plant, spark poster). Warm daylight palette, Maya in amber and Floey in pink as the brightest things. Maya sits behind the desk with the laptop (spark sticker) and a mug at the desk's right end. Floey perches on the laptop lid facing Maya, side view. The running prop is a word count pill by Maya's head (x 880, y 610): first a bad-tone bar with no number, then '1,640 words' (Maya's own example draft, the five sections add up to it), then good-tone '530 words'. The reel has one notification (beat 0) and one insert (beats 7 and 8). Flowra appears only in the end card.

panels.subject: wide: Maya behind the desk in pose type with expr worried, Floey perched on the laptop lid facing her, the mug on the desk at the right end. The bad-tone word count pill by Maya's head shows only a bar, no number. The phone notification is already sliding down at frame one.
panels.action: Maya types hard in bursts and the pill's bar ticks fuller with each burst. The notification slides down and settles: 'Core update rolling out'. Floey starts a slow head tilt toward the screen.

panels.subject: wide, nudged in slowly toward Maya so the pill, her glasses and Floey on the lid all stay inside x 60 to 1020. The notification slides back up and out.
panels.action: A sweat mark pops up beside Maya's glasses and the bar ticks fuller again. Floey finishes her tilt and stares at the screen, then slowly up at Maya.

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey alone on the laptop lid, side view, mood think.
panels.action: Hard cut on the speaker change. Floey glances down at the screen, then up toward Maya, says 'Says who, Maya?' deadpan and gives one slow blink. Off-shot the typing stops mid-word.

panels.subject: mayaTight, nudged so the pill by her head stays in frame: Maya's face fills it, expr panic, eyebrows high.
panels.action: Maya throws both hands up off the keys (pose panic) with a small panic shake. On 'two thousand' the pill flips from the bare bar to a number for the first time: '1,640 words', still bad tone.

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey on the lid, mood think, turning side-on to the laptop screen.
panels.action: Hard cut on the speaker change. Floey turns side-on and leans toward the screen as if reading aloud, flat and official: 'Google's own guide asks...'

panels.subject: floeyTight, pushing in a little on Floey as she reads.
panels.action: Floey leans in further on 'preferred word count', then gives one tongue flick at the end of the line.

panels.subject: mayaTight, pill '1,640 words' still in frame: Maya with her hands still half up from the panic pose.
panels.action: Maya freezes (MY.expr surprised) and stares toward Floey (look x -1): 'And?'

panels.subject: wide: Floey on the lid facing the screen, Maya frozen behind the desk with her mouth half open, the red '1,640 words' pill glowing by her head.
panels.action: A pull-out to both as the answer lands. Floey reads 'It answers itself.' On 'No, we don't' she swivels from the screen to Maya, then gives one smug blink (mood happy). Maya stays frozen, then her eyes go down to the laptop.

panels.subject: maya: Maya alone behind the laptop with expr worried and the pill by her head. Floey is out of frame.
panels.action: Maya leans toward the laptop (MY.leanTo), glances down at the screen, then up toward where Floey sits (look x -1, y -0.3): 'So what do I cut?'

panels.subject: Laptop screen cutaway, DUO.listInsert titled 'My draft: banana bread', with five rows: My childhood kitchen 420 words, A history of bananas 380 words, Why baking is self-care 310 words, The recipe 290 words, Storage tips 240 words.
panels.action: The insert swings in and the rows slide in one by one under Floey's voice. On 'what they searched' a bright ring grows around 'The recipe 290 words' and the three rows above it dim.

panels.subject: Same listInsert, held. If rows can't be removed, hard-cut to redrawn versions with one row fewer each time.
panels.action: Maya says 'Oh. The recipe,' and the dimmed rows go one at a time: childhood kitchen, then history of bananas, then self-care. Only 'The recipe 290 words' and 'Storage tips 240 words' are left as she says 'and how to keep it'.

panels.subject: wide: Maya behind the desk, Floey on the lid, the mug on the desk, the pill by Maya's head.
panels.action: A cut out of the insert. Maya's face is surprised, then she switches to pose type and taps once more. The pill shrinks and turns good tone at '530 words'. Floey chips on the lid at the same moment.

panels.subject: wide, pushing in gently toward Maya while keeping Floey and the green '530 words' pill inside the frame.
panels.action: Maya's face falls (expr sad). She picks up the mug: DUO.mug() stops drawing and she switches to pose mug, so there is only ever one mug. She hugs it to her chest: 'But my childhood kitchen story...' Floey turns her head and watches her sideways.

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey on the lid facing Maya, mood think.
panels.action: A cut to the speaker. Floey says 'Send it to your mom.' to Maya, deadpan. After the line she pivots front to camera (F.pivot front, mood happy), holds a beat and winks.

panels.subject: wide, with a slow push-in that keeps Maya, Floey and the green '530 words' pill inside the safe area: Maya hugs the mug in both hands.
panels.action: Maya slowly turns from Floey to the camera with expr deadpan and gives it a flat look. Hold it for about 1.8 seconds, with only a blink.

panels.subject: End card: the Flowra logo intact with Floey perched on the spark's left arm, facing the camera. Captions are hidden.
panels.action: The end card lands over the room and Floey settles on the spark's arm.
